review_rule: Read each complete visible question and company reply before seeing any v3 model response. Record a unique item-specific reason. Confirm only a concrete new company fact, current implementation or specific measurable forecast in the reply; exclude question-only claims, routine shareholder counts, old disclosure dates, static capabilities, other entities' plans and conditional approvals. Every event must use an exact reply-only quote. No future prices or unseen disclosures.
score_interpretation: Agreement with one AI reviewer on an independent company cohort, not human-ground-truth accuracy or market predictive validity.
